caption: The drawing features a cross at the top with stylized, symmetrical edges, outlined in red with gold as the base color and blue, gold, and red interior designs. Behind the cross are gold ray-like accents. Below the cross is a bow-like shape with four oval loops outlined in blue and filled with gold and red patterns, connected at the center by a circle with concentric blue, red, and gold rings. Flanking this bow-like shape are two gold, wing-like forms, each with three red tips. Below, there is a large circular design featuring an intricate mandala composed of alternating gold and red petal-like shapes, blue circular accents, and a gold center, all enclosed by a blue and red outline. The background is a textured beige color, giving the composition an aged appearance.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
